scope: Complete Cream three-voice arrangement; omissions and new SID approximations are explicit.

startup_loader.scope: Startup only. Original entry and high code restored before playback; score, instruments and playback addresses unchanged.

runtime_reserved_ranges.purpose: bootstrap/main and four native mixing kernels
clock slide, patchers, delays and interrupt templates

pcm_backend.kind: fractional Q8 source cursor with gain tables

score.transients: Offsets15/22 zero each tick; only bits0/1 of23 zero each tick; gain bits persist.

new_timbres.11: Measured complex tone approximated by pulse where not sampled.
new_timbres.12: Measured monophonic polysynth root approximated by pulse.
new_timbres.13/14/15: Measured major/minor/sus4 chords played as50Hz note arpeggios.
new_timbres.17: Broadband noise approximation where not sampled.
new_timbres.9_on_C4: Measured inharmonic tonal percussion approximated by triangle.

source_routes.SID2: C4, plus C1 pulse introduction while C4 is idle
source_routes.SID3: C2, plus C1 geioilsound introduction while C2 is idle

arrangement.omissions: C1 is omitted outside its explicit introduction allocation. Quiet gaps in an allocated voice are not filled automatically.
approximations: SID1/SID2 use quiet native pulse/triangle/noise programs.
Looped chords are50Hz major/minor/sus4 note arpeggios, not simultaneous partials.
New11/17 PCM gains use integer volume LUTs; measured code error is reported.
arrangement.scope: Complete pinned source traversal; exact approved bank data and ordinary states are preserved. Global sample-clock phase differs from the isolated26.88s preview. Perceived quality remains a listening decision.
arrangement.SID_volume_policy: AD00/SR10 and continuous GATE; zero/nonzero source-volume gating only. Nonzero SID volume slides are not reproduced. PCM gains are preserved separately.

deadlines.scope: Every full-song fill completes before its matching hardware pointer activation. Wall time includes NMI work; this is not a foreground CPU percentage.

restored_native_ram.scope: Native RAM at loader_done, before original player entry. I/O is excluded; the declared loader arena is the only excluded RAM.

cpu.scope: Complete native performance. Every NMI and buffer activation measured. Foreground fill includes SID programs, native phase/cursors and PCM mixing; prefetched note decoding is counted separately. Main-control residual includes busy waits. No separate C3 sampler exists.

attribution.scope: Exact non-overlapping wall-cycle partition of the unchanged program, excluding startup and terminal shutdown. NMI cycles are removed from every foreground interval. Main-control/busy-wait residual is not a claim that all those cycles can meet an arbitrary new deadline.

all.processing: Independent actual VICE capture, native-clock crop, DC removal and one shared constant gain. No host mixing, EQ, alignment or dynamics.

sid-1.processing: Independent actual VICE capture, native-clock crop, DC removal and one shared constant gain. No host mixing, EQ, alignment or dynamics.

sid-2.processing: Independent actual VICE capture, native-clock crop, DC removal and one shared constant gain. No host mixing, EQ, alignment or dynamics.

sid-3.processing: Independent actual VICE capture, native-clock crop, DC removal and one shared constant gain. No host mixing, EQ, alignment or dynamics.

audio_reference.scope: Actual mixed native audio compared with the approved passage. Fixed reference gain only; no candidate gain fit, sample alignment or audio writing. Independent digital verification and listening remain required.

full_capture_clock_crop.scope: Only the approved source passage is compared acoustically. The complete input length is checked; the remaining song audio is not compared against a listening reference.

coverage.scope: Every omitted active source tick, grouped into exact contiguous passages. Channel seconds can overlap; they are not silent seconds in the complete mix.

reusable_asm_banks.scope: Only bank ASM exports and their asset metadata were written. Existing PCM bins, note data, expected stream and five player PRGs are unchanged. All eight exported bank ASMs assemble together and reproduce the exact existing bank bytes, including256-byte guards.
